title: a measured answer cites a durable record by its rooted address
intention: The answer door records --measured as a dataref address (cairn:///, cairncommons:///, instance:///, outline 17.28.1.1) and refuses a record that resolves inside no durable root, so an answer's measurement is findable on every box after the worktree or scratch dir that held it is gone.
why: Measured 2026-11-21: 34 of 319 measured answers in CairnCommons/questions/ cite a record outside this box's durable roots and 32 of them no longer resolve here, among them worktree paths (wt-2a20, wt-castpair, wt-4c4a, wt-unq, wt-q126), /tmp scratchpads and akienasus's home paths. open-2921d9c2dbb8 and open-a9795e2009c1, answered today on cffb99063d09, cite files under /home/akien/dev/src/wt-hostb, a worktree cleared when its work lands. A measurement whose record vanishes is an unmeasured claim (Law 3), in a record of truth (Law 7).
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured) and Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth)
how: answer() resolves the --measured path, finds the durable roots from the artifact door's roots() followed through .git to the main checkout (D1), refuses a path under none of them, and records measured as the dataref address '<scheme>:///<posix relative path>' (D3). test_question.py's measured tooth moves its record under its scratch commons (D5). The two named records are repointed through the artifact door (D4).

clauses.claim: with roots naming a linked git worktree of a scratch repo, answer() over a record inside that worktree is refused, the refusal naming the path and the durable roots (the scratch main checkout among them, the worktree not), and the question file's bytes are unchanged
answer() over a record in a scratch dir outside every durable root is refused the same way and writes nothing

answer() over a record under the durable commons root is accepted, measured reads 'cairncommons:///<posix relative path>', answered_by starts 'measurement: cairncommons:///', and Dataref(measured, roots).path is that record
open-2921d9c2dbb8 and open-a9795e2009c1 record measured as 'cairn:///cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/<file>.md', and Dataref over that address resolves to a file on the main checkout

decisions.text: D1 (clause 1): durable_roots() in question.py returns {'cairn': main checkout, 'cairncommons': its commons, 'instance': address.ROOTS['instance']}, starting from the artifact door's roots() (the world _ticket_file already reads, so a proof's scratch world is the door's world). The main checkout is door.roots()['cairn'] when its .git is a directory or absent, and the commons is door.roots()['CairnCommons']; when .git is a file ('gitdir: <common>/worktrees/<n>'), the common dir comes from that gitdir's commondir file (relative to the gitdir), the main checkout is its parent, and the commons is the main checkout's sibling CairnCommons. No subprocess. answer() resolves measured and refuses one under none of them, naming the path and the roots, and writes nothing.
D2 (clause 2): the same check refuses a scratch_dir record, which sits under no root; tooth plants it and compares the question file's bytes before and after.

D3 (clause 3): an accepted record is stored as the dataref address '<scheme>:///<relative path, forward slashes>' (outline 17.28.1.1), the first durable root containing it in the order repo, commons, instance, the scheme read from dataref's SCHEMES inverted (repo->cairn, commons->cairncommons, instance->instance); answered_by reads 'measurement: <that address>'. The proof resolves it back through Dataref.

D4 (clause 4): open-2921d9c2dbb8 and open-a9795e2009c1 are rewritten through the artifact door (verb answer) so measured and answered_by name cairn:///cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/17-tools.md and cairn:///cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/00-how-to-read-this.md, which stand on main since c8224d38a; their words are unchanged. A tooth reads both live records (marked as reading live data) and resolves each address through Dataref to a file.

D5 (keeps c62df2454322's tooth true under the new door): teeth_measured in test_question.py writes its record under the scratch commons instead of the scratch tmp root, and expects answered_by 'measurement: cairncommons:///<name>' and measured equal to that address; the missing-record refusal (b) and the CLI path (c) keep their meaning.
